Summary: 

 Mujin is the future of industrial robotic systems in production and distribution environments. Our technology gives robots perception and awareness, enabling them to take on more advanced tasks. We aim to revolutionize the use of robotics within industry to free human resources from labor-intensive tasks to focus on more intellectual challenges.

  

 We are looking for a Frontend Developer to build real-time, operational user interfaces for robotics and warehouse automation systems. You will design and implement scalable cloud services that are integrated with advanced robotics systems. This role is ideal for developers passionate about elevating user experience through creative designs, cloud technologies, system programming, and robotics innovation.

  

 Position Description: 

 
 Build advanced web applications using React, TypeScript and MUI.

 Develop real-time dashboards for warehouse operations and robotics fleets

 Build control interfaces for monitoring and managing automation systems

 Integrate frontend systems with backend APIs (RESTful, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSockets)

 Visualize real-time telemetry and operational data from robots and sensors

 Collaborate with backend and infrastructure teams on system design

 Optimize frontend performance for real-time, high-frequency data updates

 Contribute to UI architecture and engineering standards

 Follow established coding, design, and documentation standards to help ensure the quality and reliability of frontend applications

 
  

 Position Requirements:

 Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.

  

 2+ years of experience in the following:

 
 Experience with React, TypeScript and a component library such as MUI

 Experience integrating real-time APIs (WebSockets, gRPC, RESTful, GraphQL)

 Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) in a frontend context

 Understanding of frontend architecture and performance optimization

 Experience developing cloud-connected applications

 Ability to design scalable and data-intensive UI systems

 Good written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, users, and stakeholders across different locations and time zones.

 
  

 Preferred Qualifications:

 
 Familiarity with authentication (OAuth, SAML) and cloud-based APIs

 Experience with real-time data pipelines or event-driven systems

 Cloud certifications preferred (especially AWS, e.g., Solutions Architect or Developer)

 Experience with robotics, industrial automation, or warehouse systems

 
  

  

 Physical Demands/ Work Environment:  

 The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a Team Member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

 
 Travel Requirement: 10%

 Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

 Ability to work extended hours as required

 
  

 Great Company! Great Benefits! When working with Mujin, enjoy:

 
 100% Company paid Medical, Dental, Vision option plus the opportunity to buy-up some benefits beginning the 1st of the month after hiring!

 100% Company Paid Life Insurance & Voluntary Benefits

 100% Company Paid Long and Short-Term Disability

 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) days beginning your 1st year!

 11 Paid Holidays, including (2) Floating Holidays!

 401(k) Plan!

 Parental Leave Benefits!

 Health Savings Account (HSA) option with HDHP!

 Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options for Medical and Dependent Care!

 Referral Bonuses!

 Company Stock Options in many roles!

 
  

 This Position Description is intended to describe the essential job functions, the general supplemental functions, and the essential requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of all supplemental duties, responsibilities, or non-essential requirements.

  

 Mujin is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.
